entities.summary: Wanda Wiecha-Wanot is a former female Polish volleyball player, a member of Poland women's national volleyball team in 1965–1971, a bronze medalist of the Olympic Games Mexico 1968, silver medalist of the European Championship 1967, three-time Polish Champion.
